description:
Contracts at one expiration, enriched with price + OI + volume.

    Each row: ticker (OCC), contract_type, strike, name, price, volume,
    open_interest, open_interest_change, change_percent, day_open / high /
    low, last_trade_date.

    Quotes are typically delayed ~15 minutes.

    GREEKS AND IV: the results carry price, open interest and volume;
    delta/gamma/theta/vega and implied volatility are not part of this
    data. When the user asks for greeks, IV or a '30-delta call' style
    query, fetch the chain first (get_options_expirations, then this
    tool), present the matching strikes with price, open interest and
    volume, and state plainly that greeks and IV are unavailable. Report
    only values that appear in the results, and leave delta and IV
    unestimated, including rules of thumb.

    Args:
        ticker: Underlying (e.g. 'AAPL').
        expiration_date: One of the dates from get_options_expirations
            (YYYY-MM-DD).
        contract_type: '' for both, or 'call' or 'put'.
        strike_gte: Filter strikes >= this value (optional).
        strike_lte: Filter strikes <= this value (optional).
        limit: Max contracts to return (default 50).

contract_type.description: 'call' or 'put'; omit to return both sides.
contract_type.title: Contract Type

expiration_date.description: Exact expiration in YYYY-MM-DD. REQUIRED — call get_options_expirations first to discover valid dates.
expiration_date.title: Expiration Date

name: get_options_chain
